review_status: user methodological review received; permits up to four variance-only Ridge fits
question: Does positive predicted within-H8 variance stratify the usefulness of the saved H8 mean-direction forecast, and how do joint mean-strength/sigma cells behave?

target_definitions.mean_H8: Mean of the next 8 observed one-row close-to-close log returns; reuse saved mean output and target from the prior consensus run.
target_definitions.variance_H8: Population variance (ddof=0) of the next 8 observed one-row log returns around that same interval realized mean. Describes within-interval dispersion, not conditional predictive variance of the H8 mean or uncertainty of mean-model error.
target_definitions.sigma: Square root of positive raw predicted H8 variance, in per-observed-transition log-return units. Do not apply sqrt(H) or assume independent returns.
target_definitions.gross_directional_outcome: 8 * actual_H8_mean_logreturn * sign(saved_H8_mean_prediction) * 10000 bp. Descriptive gross directional outcome, not PnL, trading profit, or maximum adverse excursion. Keep exact-zero actual outcomes as zero and count separately; exact-zero mean forecasts abstain and are counted separately.

models_and_fit_budget.mean_model: Reuse unchanged saved W16/core/Ridge(alpha=1) H8 mean predictions; no mean refit.
models_and_fit_budget.variance_models: At most one variance-only Ridge(alpha=1, fit_intercept=True, solver=cholesky) per outer fold, 4 fits total.
models_and_fit_budget.inputs: Same 21 W16/core features and exact H24-purged training/validation origins as saved mean H8 run.
models_and_fit_budget.input_scaler: Reuse saved H8 mean X StandardScaler per fold; same train origins and features.
models_and_fit_budget.variance_target_scaler: Fit StandardScaler on H8 variance targets from that fold train origins only; inverse-transform predictions.
models_and_fit_budget.raw_variance_projection: For variance MAE/calibration, use max(0, raw prediction). Report raw<0 and raw==0 separately and combined raw<=0. Exact raw zero is mathematically possible but is not evidence of certainty.
models_and_fit_budget.validation_usage: Validation outcomes do not set any scaler, edge, model or threshold.

fixed_bins.mean_strength: Per fold q33/q67 of abs(saved H8 mean predictions) on all in-sample H24-purged train origins; apply unchanged to validation.
fixed_bins.sigma: Per fold q33/q67 of sqrt(raw predicted variance) on training origins with raw predicted variance>0 only. Validation raw<=0 is a separate category outside the positive-sigma 3x3.
fixed_bins.primary_positive_grid: 3x3 mean-strength x sigma terciles for validation raw predicted variance>0.
fixed_bins.raw_nonpositive_reporting: Separate raw<0, raw==0 and combined raw<=0 counts and metrics by mean tercile and overall.
fixed_bins.ratio_secondary: abs(train H8 mean prediction)/sqrt(train raw variance prediction), only where raw variance>0; q33/q67 from these positive train rows only. Apply same-fold edges only to validation raw>0.
fixed_bins.quantile_method: Linear interpolation of train prediction values only.
fixed_bins.ties_and_empty_cells: Right-closed: <=q33, (q33,q67], >q67; exact edges go to the lower bin. Repeated edges remain repeated; empty bins/cells are reported as empty, never merged or artificially balanced.
fixed_bins.pooled_interpretation: ALL combines within-fold percentile groups; labels are fold-relative, not common absolute thresholds.

metrics.scopes: Report the full 6,163-origin H8 mean baseline, positive raw variance subset, and raw<=0 subset separately, by fold and aggregated.
per_cell_and_ratio_group: count and coverage vs all validation origins and positive-variance subset
exact-zero H8 mean target, exact-zero H8 mean forecast, exact-zero raw variance forecast, negative raw variance forecast
direction hit and denominator excluding zero actual and mean forecast
balanced accuracy only when both realized direction classes occur
saved fold train-majority accuracy and denominator on same cell/group subset
mean/median abs predicted H8 mean and positive sigma
mean/median realized absolute cumulative H8 log return in bp
variance MAE on clipped prediction, train-mean variance baseline MAE/skill, and mean prediction/actual variance calibration ratio
median and p10 gross directional outcome in bp
metrics.variance_mae: Compare max(0,raw variance prediction) with realized H8 variance; baseline is the fold train-only mean H8 variance. Skill=1-MAE_model/MAE_train_mean.
metrics.variance_calibration: Mean clipped predicted variance / mean realized H8 variance within cell; undefined if denominator zero.
metrics.direction_baseline: Use saved fold-specific train-majority H8 label; score on the same cell/group subset after excluding realized-zero outcomes.
metrics.gross_outcome: For nonzero mean forecasts, g=8*y_mean_actual*sign(y_mean_prediction)*10000 bp; report median and p10. Actual zero outcomes contribute zero; zero mean forecasts are excluded and counted.
metrics.overall_reference: Compare cells with saved full-validation H8 directional hit 50.7%; no post-hoc strategy selection.
metrics.dependence: No IID significance claims; targets and adjacent origins overlap.

data_rules.gaps: Retain every observed bar and gap-crossing return; no interpolation, history reset, calendar-hour division, or future gap filter.
data_rules.future_metadata: Gap masks/timestamps are audit metadata only, never features or selection filters.
data_rules.test: Do not read or score source rows after 2026-07-03.

limits: Previously examined historical folds, not untouched confirmation.
No profitability/trading signal claim; bid/spread coverage is incomplete.
Within-horizon variance does not equal predictive uncertainty of the H8 mean.
High predicted variance may or may not reduce directional usefulness; test empirically.
outputs: outer predictions separating forecasts and actuals
